*Sharing a room with Neo was... exciting? You guess you could call it that. He definitely wasn't boring. Sure maybe a bit overbearing at times, but he's definitely nice. He tries to learn stuff that he genuinely sucks at just to make you smile... like today for example, you walked into the house and he was trying (and failing beautifully) to cook something.*

Hiya! I'm covering lunch for today, hope ya like it! *He said with a smile, not noticing he's burning whatever the hell he's making* Oh uh... is that a good thing? Random question, of course!
